---
title: "S3 - Processing Pink Variables and Creating SMM Column"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(here)
library(knitr)

here::i_am('scripts/s3_processing_pink_variables.Rmd')

pink_path     <- here("outputs/s2/v1_2_pink_variables_clean.csv")
codebook_path <- here("data/general/HIGHLIGHTED_nuMoM2b_Merged_Dataset_Codebook_9.14.25.xlsx")
merged_path   <- here("data/general/nuMoM2b_Merged_Dataset.csv")
blue_path     <- here("outputs/s1/v1_6_blue_variables_35_final.xlsx")
out_dir       <- here("outputs/s3")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r step1-remove-variables}
# ============================================================
# Step 1: Read pink dataset and remove specified variables
# ============================================================

pink <- read_csv(pink_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

message("Rows loaded: ", nrow(pink))
message("Cols loaded (incl. PublicID): ", ncol(pink))

# Variables to remove
vars_smm_na <- c(
  "CMAE11e_SP", "CMAE12c", "CMAE13c1", "CMAE13c2",
  "CMAE13c3", "CMAE13c4", "CMAE13c4_SP", "CMAI01A_INT"
)

vars_smm_rf <- c(
  "CMBJ04", "CMBJ04_1", "CMBJ04_2", "CMBJ04_3", "CMBJ04_4",
  "CMDA08c", "CMEA03"
)

vars_remove_other <- c("A04A05")

all_vars_to_remove <- c(vars_smm_na, vars_smm_rf, vars_remove_other)

actually_removed <- intersect(all_vars_to_remove, names(pink))
not_found        <- setdiff(all_vars_to_remove, names(pink))

message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("NOTE: Variables to remove (SMM = NA):         ", length(vars_smm_na))
message("NOTE: Variables to remove (SMM = RF):         ", length(vars_smm_rf))
message("NOTE: Variables to remove (other):            ", length(vars_remove_other))
message("NOTE: Total variables to remove:              ", length(all_vars_to_remove))
message("NOTE: Actually found and removed:             ", length(actually_removed))
if (length(not_found) > 0) {
  message("WARNING: Not found in dataset: ", paste(not_found, collapse = ", "))
}
message("--------------------------------------------------")

pink_reduced <- pink %>%
  select(-any_of(all_vars_to_remove))

remaining_vars <- setdiff(names(pink_reduced), "PublicID")

message("Cols before removal (excl. PublicID): ", ncol(pink) - 1)
message("Cols after removal  (excl. PublicID): ", length(remaining_vars))
message("Rows unchanged: ", nrow(pink_reduced))
```

```{r step2-codebook-lookup}
# ============================================================
# Step 2: Look up Variable_Code_List_if_Coded for each
#         remaining pink variable
# ============================================================

cb <- read_excel(codebook_path, sheet = "nuMoM2b_Variables")

cb_var_col  <- names(cb)[tolower(names(cb)) == "variable_name"][1]
cb_code_col <- names(cb)[tolower(names(cb)) == "variable_code_list_if_coded"][1]

if (is.na(cb_var_col))  stop("Cannot find Variable_Name column in codebook.")
if (is.na(cb_code_col)) stop("Cannot find Variable_Code_List_if_Coded column in codebook.")

cb_small <- cb %>%
  transmute(
    variable                    = as.character(.data[[cb_var_col]]),
    Variable_Code_List_if_Coded = as.character(.data[[cb_code_col]])
  )

lookup <- tibble(variable = remaining_vars) %>%
  left_join(cb_small, by = "variable") %>%
  mutate(
    code_value = case_when(
      is.na(Variable_Code_List_if_Coded) |
        trimws(Variable_Code_List_if_Coded) == "" ~ "NA_or_blank",
      TRUE ~ trimws(Variable_Code_List_if_Coded)
    )
  )

code_summary <- lookup %>%
  count(code_value, name = "n_variables") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_variables))

message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("NOTE: Variable_Code_List_if_Coded summary for remaining ",
        length(remaining_vars), " pink variables:")
message("--------------------------------------------------")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(code_summary))) {
  message(sprintf("  %-35s : %d variable(s)",
                  code_summary$code_value[i], code_summary$n_variables[i]))
}

na_blank_vars <- lookup %>% filter(code_value == "NA_or_blank") %>% pull(variable)
message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("NOTE: NA_or_blank variables (", length(na_blank_vars), " total):")
for (v in na_blank_vars) message("  ", v)
message("--------------------------------------------------")

write_csv(lookup,       file.path(out_dir, "v1_1_pink_remaining_code_lookup.csv"))
write_csv(code_summary, file.path(out_dir, "v1_2_code_value_summary.csv"))
message("Saved: outputs/s3/v1_1_pink_remaining_code_lookup.csv")
message("Saved: outputs/s3/v1_2_code_value_summary.csv")
```

```{r step3-remove-sp-vars}
# ============================================================
# Step 3: Remove A04A03c_SP and A04A03c_SP_1
# ============================================================

vars_step3_remove <- c("A04A03c_SP", "A04A03c_SP_1")

actually_step3 <- intersect(vars_step3_remove, names(pink_reduced))
message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("NOTE: Step 3 — removing: ", paste(actually_step3, collapse = ", "))
message("NOTE: Cols before step 3 (excl. PublicID): ", length(remaining_vars))

pink_step3 <- pink_reduced %>%
  select(-any_of(vars_step3_remove))

remaining_vars2 <- setdiff(names(pink_step3), "PublicID")
message("NOTE: Cols after  step 3 (excl. PublicID): ", length(remaining_vars2))
message("--------------------------------------------------")

lookup2 <- lookup %>% filter(!variable %in% vars_step3_remove)
```

```{r step4-smm-dict-matching}
# ============================================================
# Step 4: SMM from free-text SP variables
#
# Each SP variable has its own approved exact-value list.
# A row is flagged only when its text exactly matches
# (case-insensitive) one of the approved values for that variable.
#
# Variables and their approved trigger values:
#
# CMAE15a_sp:
#   pulmonary edema, Intubation post-operation,
#   MILD PULMONARY EDEMA, Pulmonary edema,
#   Respiratory distress, acute renal failure,
#   aspiration pneumonia,
#   disseminated intravascular coagulation,
#   respiratory failure
#
# CMAE15b_sp:
#   Acute Respiratory Distress, SEPTIC SHOCK
#
# CMAE15c_sp:
#   HYSTERECTOMY
#
# CMAE15d_sp:
#   (none — no value triggers SMM=1)
#
# CMAJ01d5_SP:
#   cardiodyopathy, cardiomyopathy
#
# All other NA_or_blank SP variables (CMAD01h_SP, CMAD01i_SP,
# CMAJ01d1_SP, A04A05_1) retain the original smm_dict
# keyword-matching approach.
# ============================================================

# --- 4a) Exact-value lists per SP variable -------------------

sp_exact <- list(
  CMAE15a_sp = c(
    "pulmonary edema",
    "intubation post-operation",
    "mild pulmonary edema",
    "respiratory distress",
    "acute renal failure",
    "aspiration pneumonia",
    "disseminated intravascular coagulation",
    "respiratory failure"
  ),
  CMAE15b_sp = c(
    "acute respiratory distress",
    "septic shock"
  ),
  CMAE15c_sp = c(
    "hysterectomy"
  ),
  CMAE15d_sp  = character(0),   # no approved values
  CMAJ01d5_SP = c(
    "cardiodyopathy",            # preserve original misspelling from data
    "cardiomyopathy"
  )
)

# Helper: exact match (case-insensitive, after trimming whitespace)
exact_match_smm <- function(x, approved_vals) {
  if (length(approved_vals) == 0) return(rep(FALSE, length(x)))
  x_lower <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  x_lower[is.na(x)] <- ""
  x_lower %in% str_to_lower(approved_vals)
}

# Build trigger flags for exact-match SP variables
sp_exact_vars_present <- intersect(names(sp_exact), names(pink_step3))
sp_exact_vars_missing <- setdiff(names(sp_exact), names(pink_step3))

message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("NOTE: Step 4a — exact-match SP variables (", length(sp_exact_vars_present), " present):")
for (v in sp_exact_vars_present) {
  n_approved <- length(sp_exact[[v]])
  message(sprintf("  %-20s : %d approved value(s)", v, n_approved))
}
if (length(sp_exact_vars_missing) > 0)
  message("WARNING: not found in dataset: ",
          paste(sp_exact_vars_missing, collapse = ", "))
message("--------------------------------------------------")

trigger_exact <- map_dfc(sp_exact_vars_present, function(v) {
  tibble(!!v := exact_match_smm(pink_step3[[v]], sp_exact[[v]]))
})

smm_from_exact <- as.integer(
  if (ncol(trigger_exact) > 0) rowSums(trigger_exact, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  else rep(FALSE, nrow(pink_step3))
)

message("NOTE: Rows triggered SMM=1 by exact SP matching: ", sum(smm_from_exact))

# --- 4b) smm_dict keyword matching for remaining SP variables ----

smm_dict <- list(
  smm_core = c(
    "severe maternal morbidity", "maternal morbidity", "smm"
  ),
  transfusion_hemorrhage = c(
    "transfusion", "massive transfusion", "blood products",
    "pph", "postpartum hemorrhage", "hemorrhage", "haemorrhage",
    "atony", "uterine atony", "d&c", "dilation and curettage",
    "hysterectomy", "peripartum hysterectomy"
  ),
  hypertensive = c(
    "preeclampsia", "eclampsia", "hellp",
    "severe features", "magnesium sulfate", "magnesium",
    "hypertensive emergency"
  ),
  infection_sepsis = c(
    "sepsis", "septic", "bacteremia", "endometritis",
    "chorioamnionitis", "infection", "shock", "anaphylaxis", "analphylactic"
  ),
  thromboembolic = c(
    "embolism", "pulmonary embolism", "pe", "emboli",
    "dvt", "deep vein thrombosis",
    "thrombosis", "air embolus", "air embolism"
  ),
  amniotic_fluid_embolism = c("amniotic fluid embolism"),
  sickle_cell = c(
    "sickle cell", "Hb SS", "Hb-SS", "Hb-C", "thalassemia"
  ),
  disseminated_intravascular_coagulation = c(
    "disseminated intravascular coagulation", "coagulation"
  ),
  respiratory = c(
    "respiratory failure", "ventilation", "intubation",
    "ards", "oxygen", "hypoxia", "pulmonary edema", "pulmonary insufficiency"
  ),
  cardiac = c(
    "cardiac arrest", "arrest", "myocardial infarction", "ventricular failure",
    "heart failure", "cardiomyopathy", "arrhythmia", "heart block", "cor pulmonale"
  ),
  puerperal_cerebrovascular_disorders = c(
    "puerperal cerebrovascular disorders", "encephalopathy", "cerebral ischemic",
    "retinal artery", "subarachnoid hemorrhage", "cerebral infarction",
    "cerebrovascular disease"
  ),
  neuro = c(
    "stroke", "cva", "seizure", "intracranial", "coma"
  ),
  renal_hepatic = c(
    "renal failure", "dialysis", "acute kidney injury", "aki",
    "liver failure", "hepatic failure"
  ),
  aneurysm = c(
    "aneurysm", "aorta", "aortic", "aortic dissection",
    "liver failure", "hepatic failure"
  ),
  hysterectomy = c(
    "hysterectomy", "resection of uterus", "uterus resection", "uterus removal",
    "removal of uterus", "hepatic failure"
  ),
  tracheostomy = c(
    "tracheostomy", "trach", "trachea", "windpipe"
  ),
  anesthesia_related = c(
    "high spinal", "local anesthetic toxicity", "last", "ventilation",
    "dural puncture", "total spinal", "failure to intubate",
    "failure to ventilate", "hemodynamic collapse", "hemodynamic instability",
    "anesthesia related", "due to anesthesia", "malignant hyperthermia",
    "aspirate", "aspiration"
  )
)

smm_keywords <- unique(str_trim(str_to_lower(unlist(smm_dict, use.names = FALSE))))
smm_keywords  <- smm_keywords[smm_keywords != ""]

has_keyword <- function(x, keywords) {
  x_lower <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  x_lower[is.na(x_lower)] <- ""
  map_lgl(x_lower, ~ any(str_detect(.x, fixed(keywords, ignore_case = TRUE))))
}

# SP variables handled by dict keyword matching (not exact-match)
vars_dict_match <- c("CMAD01h_SP", "CMAD01i_SP", "CMAJ01d1_SP", "A04A05_1")

vars_dict_present <- intersect(vars_dict_match, names(pink_step3))
vars_dict_missing <- setdiff(vars_dict_match, names(pink_step3))

message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("NOTE: Step 4b — smm_dict matching variables (", length(vars_dict_present), " present):")
for (v in vars_dict_present) message("  ", v)
if (length(vars_dict_missing) > 0)
  message("WARNING: not found in dataset: ", paste(vars_dict_missing, collapse = ", "))
message("--------------------------------------------------")

trigger_dict <- map_dfc(vars_dict_present, function(v) {
  tibble(!!v := has_keyword(pink_step3[[v]], smm_keywords))
})

smm_from_dict <- as.integer(
  if (ncol(trigger_dict) > 0) rowSums(trigger_dict, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  else rep(FALSE, nrow(pink_step3))
)

message("NOTE: Rows triggered SMM=1 by smm_dict keyword matching: ", sum(smm_from_dict))

# Combined text SMM flag (exact OR dict)
smm_from_text <- as.integer(smm_from_exact == 1 | smm_from_dict == 1)
message("NOTE: Rows triggered SMM=1 by any text method: ", sum(smm_from_text))
```

```{r step5-coded-variables}
# ============================================================
# Step 5: SMM from coded variables
#         Event_Related        : value 1 or 2 => SMM=1
#         Adverse_Event_v1,
#         Checked, Yes_No_v1,
#         Yes_No_v4, Yes_No_v5 : value 1      => SMM=1
# ============================================================

handled_vars <- c(
  names(sp_exact),        # exact-match SP vars
  vars_dict_present,      # dict-match SP vars
  vars_step3_remove,
  all_vars_to_remove
)

lookup_coded <- lookup2 %>%
  filter(!variable %in% handled_vars)

vars_event_related <- lookup_coded %>%
  filter(code_value == "Event_Related") %>% pull(variable)

vars_value1 <- lookup_coded %>%
  filter(code_value %in% c(
    "Adverse_Event_v1", "Checked", "Yes_No_v1", "Yes_No_v4", "Yes_No_v5"
  )) %>% pull(variable)

message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("NOTE: Step 5 — Event_Related variables (value 1 or 2 => SMM=1): ",
        length(vars_event_related))
for (v in vars_event_related) message("  ", v)
message("NOTE: Step 5 — value=1 variables (Adverse_Event/Checked/Yes_No): ",
        length(vars_value1))
message("--------------------------------------------------")

is_value <- function(x, vals) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_trim(as.character(x))))
  !is.na(x_num) & x_num %in% vals
}

trigger_er <- map_dfc(
  intersect(vars_event_related, names(pink_step3)),
  function(v) tibble(!!v := is_value(pink_step3[[v]], c(1, 2)))
)

trigger_v1 <- map_dfc(
  intersect(vars_value1, names(pink_step3)),
  function(v) tibble(!!v := is_value(pink_step3[[v]], 1))
)

smm_from_er <- as.integer(
  if (ncol(trigger_er) > 0) rowSums(trigger_er, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  else rep(FALSE, nrow(pink_step3))
)

smm_from_v1 <- as.integer(
  if (ncol(trigger_v1) > 0) rowSums(trigger_v1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  else rep(FALSE, nrow(pink_step3))
)

message("NOTE: Rows triggered SMM=1 by Event_Related (1 or 2): ", sum(smm_from_er))
message("NOTE: Rows triggered SMM=1 by value=1 coded vars:     ", sum(smm_from_v1))
```

```{r create-smm-column}
# ============================================================
# Final: Combine all SMM triggers -> SMM column
# ============================================================

smm_numeric <- as.integer(smm_from_er == 1 | smm_from_v1 == 1)
smm_final   <- as.integer(smm_numeric  == 1 | smm_from_text == 1)

pink_with_smm <- pink_step3 %>%
  mutate(SMM = smm_final)

n_smm1  <- sum(pink_with_smm$SMM == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_total <- nrow(pink_with_smm)
rate    <- round(n_smm1 / n_total * 100, 2)

message("==================================================")
message("FINAL SMM SUMMARY")
message("==================================================")
message("NOTE: Total rows:       ", n_total)
message("NOTE: SMM = 1:          ", n_smm1)
message("NOTE: SMM = 0:          ", n_total - n_smm1)
message("NOTE: SMM = 1 rate:     ", rate, "%")
message("==================================================")
```

```{r smm-attribution-table}
# ============================================================
# SMM Attribution Summary Table
# How was each SMM=1 individual identified?
#   - numeric only  : coded variables fired, text did not
#   - text only     : text matching fired, coded did not
#   - both          : both methods fired
# ============================================================

flag_numeric <- smm_numeric == 1
flag_text    <- smm_from_text == 1

n_numeric_only <- sum( flag_numeric & !flag_text)
n_text_only    <- sum(!flag_numeric &  flag_text)
n_both         <- sum( flag_numeric &  flag_text)
n_total_smm1   <- sum( flag_numeric |  flag_text)

attribution_df <- tibble(
  `SMM Definition Method`     = c(
    "Numeric (coded variables) only",
    "Text matching (SP fields) only",
    "Both numeric AND text",
    "Total SMM = 1"
  ),
  `N individuals` = c(
    n_numeric_only,
    n_text_only,
    n_both,
    n_total_smm1
  ),
  `% of total cohort` = round(
    c(n_numeric_only, n_text_only, n_both, n_total_smm1) / n_total * 100, 2
  ),
  `% of SMM=1` = round(
    c(n_numeric_only, n_text_only, n_both, n_total_smm1) / n_total_smm1 * 100, 2
  )
)

kable(attribution_df, caption = "SMM = 1 Attribution Summary")
```

```{r save-outputs}
# ============================================================
# Save outputs
#
# Dataset 1: blue variables + SMM
# Dataset 2: Dataset 1 + additional CMAC15 columns from
#            nuMoM2b_Merged_Dataset.csv
# ============================================================

# --- Load blue variables (35 final variables from s1) ---
blue <- readxl::read_xlsx(blue_path)
message("Blue variables loaded: ", nrow(blue), " rows x ", ncol(blue), " cols")

# --- Build Dataset 1: blue + SMM ---
smm_key <- pink_with_smm %>% select(PublicID, SMM)

dataset1 <- blue %>%
  left_join(smm_key, by = "PublicID")

message("Dataset 1 shape: ", nrow(dataset1), " rows x ", ncol(dataset1), " cols")

# --- Load merged dataset for extra CMAC15 columns ---
extra_cols <- c(
  "PublicID",
  "CMAC15b",
  "CMAC15a1Pri", "CMAC15a1Sec",
  "CMAC15a2Pri", "CMAC15a2Sec",
  "CMAC15a3Pri", "CMAC15a3Sec",
  "CMAC15a4Pri", "CMAC15a4Sec",
  "CMAC15a5Pri", "CMAC15a5Sec",
  "CMAC15a7Pri", "CMAC15a7Sec",
  "CMAC15a8Pri", "CMAC15a8Sec",
  "CMAC15a8a",
  "CMAC15a11Pri", "CMAC15a11Sec"
)

merged_raw <- read_csv(merged_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

extra_cols_present <- intersect(extra_cols, names(merged_raw))
extra_cols_missing <- setdiff(extra_cols, names(merged_raw))

if (length(extra_cols_missing) > 0)
  message("WARNING: extra cols not found in merged dataset: ",
          paste(extra_cols_missing, collapse = ", "))

merged_extra <- merged_raw %>%
  select(all_of(extra_cols_present))

# --- Build Dataset 2: Dataset 1 + CMAC15 columns ---
dataset2 <- dataset1 %>%
  left_join(merged_extra, by = "PublicID")

message("Dataset 2 shape: ", nrow(dataset2), " rows x ", ncol(dataset2), " cols")

# --- Save ---
write_csv(dataset1, file.path(out_dir, "v2_1_blue_with_SMM.csv"))
write_csv(dataset2, file.path(out_dir, "v2_2_blue_with_SMM_extended.csv"))

# Also save the intermediate pink+SMM files (unchanged from v1)
smm_output <- pink_with_smm %>% select(PublicID, SMM)
write_csv(pink_with_smm, file.path(out_dir, "v1_3_pink_with_SMM.csv"))
saveRDS(pink_with_smm,   file.path(out_dir, "v1_3_pink_with_SMM.rds"))
write_csv(smm_output,    file.path(out_dir, "v1_4_SMM_final.csv"))
saveRDS(smm_output,      file.path(out_dir, "v1_4_SMM_final.rds"))

message("Saved: outputs/s3/v1_5_blue_with_SMM.csv          (blue vars + SMM)")
message("Saved: outputs/s3/v1_6_blue_with_SMM_extended.csv (blue vars + SMM + CMAC15)")
message("Saved: outputs/s3/v1_3_pink_with_SMM.csv          (all pink vars + SMM)")
message("Saved: outputs/s3/v1_4_SMM_final.csv              (PublicID + SMM only)")
```

```{r missing-rate-final-check}
# ============================================================
# Step 7: Missing rate for each variable in v2_1_blue_with_SMM.csv
# ============================================================

final_check_df <- read_csv(file.path(out_dir, "v2_1_blue_with_SMM.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)

check_vars <- setdiff(names(final_check_df), "PublicID")
n_rows_chk <- nrow(final_check_df)

missing_rate_check <- tibble(variable = check_vars) %>%
  mutate(
    n_missing    = sapply(variable, function(v) sum(is.na(final_check_df[[v]]))),
    n_total      = n_rows_chk,
    missing_rate = round(n_missing / n_total * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_rate))

n_vars_chk <- length(check_vars)

kable(
  missing_rate_check,
  col.names = c("Variable", "N Missing", "N Total", "Missing Rate (%)"),
  caption   = paste0("Missing rate for each of the ", n_vars_chk,
                     " variables in v2_1_blue_with_SMM.csv")
)
```
